reportingDefinitions.window: UTC instants, start inclusive and end exclusive; canonical outcomes by creation time.
reportingDefinitions.unique: Distinct current-consent site subject hashes, never people, email or member identities.
reportingDefinitions.attribution: Within selected window, same consent subject and earlier observed campaign landing; last non-direct credit, first-touch comparison. Labels are self-reported, not proof of an external dispatch or causation. One canonical outcome counts once.
reportingDefinitions.finance: Paid/fulfilling/fulfilled orders with receipt; gross presentment amountMinor by currency. No snapshot addition, FX, provider payout, fees or net claim; refunds excluded.
reportingDefinitions.freshness: Latest eligible receivedAt in selected window; not a pipeline uptime guarantee.
reportingDefinitions.uncertainty: Unconsented, withdrawn, expired, blocked and unlinked traffic is unknown. No identity inference. Empty arrays mean no eligible records in this window.

sourceFreshness.countBasis: All retained current-consent events in selected window; not total site traffic.

uncertaintyAndMissingData.disclosureStatement: Unconsented traffic is not collected; its volume and rejected or duplicate request counts are unknown.

definition.name: Homepage Hero CTA & Reader Onboarding Optimization
definition.description: Testing Sovereign Dispatch CTA (Control) vs. Free Reader Network CTA (Treatment) for reader conversion.

variants.name: Sovereign Dispatch (Control)
variants.headline: Subscribe to Sovereign Dispatch
variants.tagline: Independent journalism, unfiltered dispatches, zero corporate tracking.

variants.name: Free Reader Network (Treatment)
variants.headline: Join the Sovereign Reader Network
variants.tagline: Full access to decentralised analysis, community discussions, and verified member feeds.

warnings: Tiny sample: fewer than 100 exposures in at least one variant.
Insufficient evidence: do not select a winner or stop early.

page_views.label: Consented Page Views
page_views.definition: Total successful page view beacons received from consented visitor sessions.
caveats: Excludes unconsented visitors, bot/crawler user agents, and requests marked internal.
Subject to ad-blockers and privacy shields; treat as lower bound of client observations.
page_views.uncertaintyDisclosure: Represents consented client observations only. Unconsented traffic is reported separately as missing data.

unique_visitors.label: Estimated Unique Visitors
unique_visitors.grain: Site-scoped consent subject over retained events
unique_visitors.definition: Distinct consent subjects represented in retained accepted events; not a count of people.
caveats: Subject hashes are site-scoped and linked events are purged on withdrawal.
Multiple browsers and cleared consent cookies can count one person more than once.
unique_visitors.uncertaintyDisclosure: Consent subjects do not establish unique human identity.

disclosed_campaign_clicks.label: Disclosed Campaign & Referral Touchpoints
disclosed_campaign_clicks.formula: COUNT(current_consent_page_views WHERE utm_campaign IS NOT NULL)
disclosed_campaign_clicks.source: Observed minimal UTM campaign labels on consented page views
disclosed_campaign_clicks.definition: Observed campaign landings with self-reported UTM labels; not proof of external link clicks.
caveats: Only recorded when the visitor grants analytics consent upon landing.
Stripped or truncated UTM parameters by privacy proxies may result in direct classification.
disclosed_campaign_clicks.uncertaintyDisclosure: Unconsented arrivals via campaigns cannot be tracked or credited without violating privacy.

conversions.label: Verified Goal Conversions
conversions.grain: Raw event reconciled against canonical collection
conversions.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT canonical sourceEventId with same-subject prior campaign landing)
conversions.source: Canonical form submissions and authorized observations of paid order receipts
conversions.definition: Persisted form submissions and paid order receipt observations linked to current analytics consent.
caveats: Reconciled against canonical business records in PostgreSQL.
Failed payments, abandoned carts, and unverified double opt-in signups are excluded.
conversions.uncertaintyDisclosure: Only persisted canonical outcomes are verified; browser observations alone cannot establish a business conversion.

conversion_rate.label: Consented Conversion Rate (CR)
conversion_rate.formula: (Distinct converted consent subjects / Distinct landing consent subjects) * 100
conversion_rate.definition: Percentage of consented visitors who completed the specified goal.
caveats: Calculated over consented sessions only; unconsented visitors are excluded from both numerator and denominator.
conversion_rate.uncertaintyDisclosure: Descriptive same-subject linkage, not evidence of causation or cross-device identity.

experiment_exposures.label: Experiment Variant Exposures
experiment_exposures.definition: Unique verified visitor encounters with a specific experiment variant.
caveats: Deduped per assignment key; repeat pageviews within the same session do not inflate exposures.
Unconsented visitors receive default control without recording an exposure event.
experiment_exposures.uncertaintyDisclosure: Zero exposure telemetry recorded for privacy-shielded or unconsented traffic.

practical_effect.label: Practical Effect (Lift)
practical_effect.definition: Absolute difference in conversion rate between the treatment variant and the control baseline.
caveats: Must be interpreted in conjunction with sample size and 95% confidence bounds.
Early stopping on small sample sizes (< 100) produces false positive results.
practical_effect.uncertaintyDisclosure: Tiny samples (< 100 per variant) are explicitly flagged with insufficient evidence warnings.

financial_gross.label: Currency-Separated Gross Volume
financial_gross.grain: Canonical order created within selected window
financial_gross.formula: SUM(orders.amountMinor WHERE paid state AND receipt) GROUP BY currency
financial_gross.source: Canonical orders and settled payment records
financial_gross.definition: Gross presentment value of paid, fulfilling or fulfilled receipted orders; refunded orders excluded.
caveats: Never merged across distinct currencies without explicit historical exchange rates.
Reported in minor units (e.g., cents, pence) to prevent floating point inaccuracies.
financial_gross.uncertaintyDisclosure: Provider payout, fees and net settlement unknown; snapshots never added to canonical orders.

eventInventory.name: First-Party Client Web Telemetry
eventInventory.suppressionBehavior: Persisted consent withdrawal blocks collection and purges linked raw events; browser consent subjects are never joined to email suppression hashes.
uncertaintyDisclosures: Filtered when DNT/GPC headers are present or consent is not granted.
Unique counts describe site-scoped consent subjects, not distinct people.
Client-side ad-blockers may prevent beacon delivery; treat as lower-bound baseline.

eventInventory.name: Consent & Privacy Preference Evidence
eventInventory.suppressionBehavior: Email suppressions remain separate; browser withdrawals generate immutable records and purge linked analytics events.
uncertaintyDisclosures: Reflects verified browser storage; does not imply email or telecom marketing consent.
Withdrawals immediately purge active session and anonymous tracking cookies.

eventInventory.name: Audience & Form Interactions
eventInventory.suppressionBehavior: Suppressed emails blocked from campaigns and masked with < 5 privacy floor in reports.
uncertaintyDisclosures: Submissions require double opt-in confirmation before inclusion in verified audience reach.
Honeypot, challenge, and rate-limited entries are isolated from conversion metrics.

eventInventory.name: Community & Discussion Telemetry
eventInventory.suppressionBehavior: Blocked members and quarantined posts scrubbed from public projections.
uncertaintyDisclosures: Public engagement metrics reflect non-quarantined content only.
Direct message metadata excludes message body content for end-to-end privacy.

eventInventory.name: Commerce, Orders & Payment Snapshots
eventInventory.suppressionBehavior: Suppression does not delete financial audit records required by legal or tax regulations.
uncertaintyDisclosures: Currency separation is strictly enforced: distinct presentment/settlement currencies are never summed without provenance-tagged exchange rates.
Distinguishes reconciled canonical payments, provider-reported webhooks, and estimated affiliate commissions.

eventInventory.name: Experience Experiments & Variant Outcomes
eventInventory.suppressionBehavior: Suppressed visitors receive deterministic control and generate zero experiment telemetry.
uncertaintyDisclosures: Unconsented or privacy-controlled visitors are served the control variant with isDefault: true.
Early stopping prohibited: statistical significance requires sample size >= 100 per variant.
Winner selection requires explicit human operator approval and recorded rationale.

eventInventory.name: Suppression & Right-to-be-Forgotten Ledger
eventInventory.suppressionBehavior: Authoritative barrier: hashed emails are permanently blocked from outbound dispatch and masked in reports.
uncertaintyDisclosures: One-way SHA-256 hashed emails prevent re-identification while preserving compliance audit proof.
Never exposed in cleartext in operator reporting surfaces.
